evidence.entry: H5 游戏根目录必须包含 index.html 文件。
evidence.upload: prepare_h5_upload checks output directory; upload_h5_game uses selected app/developer and returns review status.
evidence.orientation: screenOrientation enum: 1 portrait, 2 landscape; selected app metadata is checked by upload workflow.
evidence.host_api: NO npm packages or SDK installation required; tap is a GLOBAL object provided by TapTap runtime environment.
evidence.optional_services: Leaderboard, cloud save, share and ad APIs are separate services; this offline single-player build does not enable them.

scope: User explicitly confirmed TapTap H5/mini-game ZIP; standalone web runtime. No account-side app selected, no platform upload or review performed.
limitations: Developer website blocked by environment egress policy. Requirements verified using official published package; no claim of checking private account settings or all current server-side review rules.
